passives.name: Come Here, Hound
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Unaffected by Stunned. Reduces damage taken by allies from attacks that target all enemies by [Buff_V_2000088_2_1] and [Buff_V_2000088_2_2] of damage dealt to allies is redirected to the caster. (Only the effect with the highest value is applied.) (Triggered Effect) After being hit, uses Come Here, Hound on the enemy with the lowest Max Health. Has a [Buff_C_2000088_2_4] chance to inflict Petrified on the target for [Buff_T_2000088_2_4] turn(s). This skill’s damage dealt increases proportional to Max Health instead of Attack.
